text:
Lee: found an ancient scroll: 'semver rites and the YAML altar' :rolled_up_newspaper:
Nina: please tell me incense is optional. :pray:
Lee: optional but recommended. comic attached: dev chanting while aligning spaces.
Tom: real talk: accidentally changing a single space bumped version and triggered a rollback once. true horror. :scream:
Nina: we need a 12-step program: 1) don't sed -i, 2) run a linter, 3) blame the whitespace.
CI-bot: nina/patch: lint failed - parser error at infra/services.yml:14 (found tab)
Lee: yep, the universe punishes misplaced tabs.
Tom: poll: is semver a contract or a superstition? :thinking:
Nina: contract with clauses written in tears.
Lee: superstition if you deploy on Friday afternoons.
Tom: code for the history books:
```yaml
app:
  name: soda-station
  version: "2.3.4"  # bumped to 2.3.5, then a rogue tab happened
  features:
    ice: true
    syrup: mango
```
Nina: caption: "commit message: fixed version bump" :face_with_hand_over_mouth:
Lee: adding 'YAML exorcism' to lunch topics. stickers optional.
CI-bot: created issue #6006 'YAML-exorcism lunch session'
Tom: if someone builds a bot to auto-fix semver whitespace, I'll buy it coffee.
Nina: deal. I will prototype the coffee script.
Lee: closing thread—remember backups before ritual edits. :bookmark:
